Engineering Roadmap, H1 Prepared for the leadership team — May 2026
02 / 05

Where we are today

Aurora's core platform shipped to GA in March. Adoption is ahead of plan but several rough edges have surfaced in the long tail of customers.

Wins so far

3,400 active workspaces. Median time-to-first-value is now 4 minutes (target was 8). NPS at 47.

Open issues

Mobile experience is below bar. Permissions UI causes confusion in 22% of customer interviews. SSO setup takes too long for enterprise.

03 / 05

H1 2026 priorities

Three focus areas. Everything else is explicitly out of scope until July.

P1 — Mobile-first redesign

Native iOS and Android apps. Web responsive overhaul. Owner: Ana K. Beta in May, GA in June.

P2 — Permissions v2

Role-based access with team templates. Owner: Devon S. Internal alpha by mid-April.

P3 — Enterprise SSO

SCIM provisioning, SAML/OIDC, audit logs. Owner: Priya R. Customer pilots in May.

Out of scope

API redesign, billing portal, marketplace integrations. Revisit for H2 planning.

04 / 05

Quarterly milestones

Concrete dates we're holding ourselves to.

Q1

Permissions v2 internal alpha. Mobile design system v1 frozen. SSO discovery interviews complete.

Q2 early

iOS beta to design partners. Permissions v2 in 10% rollout. SSO pilot with 3 enterprise customers.

Q2 late

Mobile GA. Permissions v2 GA. SSO available for all paid plans. H2 planning kickoff.
